series_definitions.response_latency_ms: Client request timing start to completion.
series_definitions.before_first_useful_output_ms: Dispatch to first useful output; includes offset before client timing start. Missing origin remains unavailable.
series_definitions.first_useful_output_ms: Client request timing start to first useful answer/tool output.
series_definitions.answer_streaming_ms: First to last answer receipt; not continuous server generation timing.
series_definitions.completion_tail_ms: Last answer receipt to recorded request completion, with matching timing origin; client elapsed fallback when absolute origins absent.
series_definitions.client_ttft_ms: Client request timing start to first generated-content event. Distinct from first useful output.
